label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value rememberMeKey = Float.toString(Random.nextFloat()).substring(2) which derives from weak java.util.Random, used for session token generation. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes rememberMe.getValue() containing user-provided cookie value (derived from POST parameter) printed to response writer. Both alerts represent genuine vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Weak RNG source: new java.util.Random().nextFloat() generates insecure random value
Sink: rememberMeKey assigned from trimmed random float string
Response prints user+cookie info including rememberMe.getValue() containing user-supplied cookie value
